about: Cross-section values of the VT350's aluminium extrusions, for the frame beam model (platform/fem/frame.py, vt350#322). mm, mm^2, mm^4. w >= h: Iw bends the bar so it deflects along its w (wide) side, Ih along its h side; for a square profile they are equal.
source: Misumi HFS5 series catalogue (slot 6), sectional area and second moments of area: HFS5-2020 183 mm^2, 0.742e4 mm^4 both axes; HFS5-2040 324 mm^2, 1.358e4 / 5.13e4 mm^4; HFS5-4040 472 mm^2, 8.89e4 mm^4 both axes. https://in.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2015/p2_557.pdf, https://api.uk.misumi-ec.com/vona2/detail/110302684350. No supplier is chosen yet (bom/buying-rounds.md, vt350#7): these are typical 20 mm series values; check them against the chosen supplier's data.
J_note: PLACEHOLDER. Misumi doesn't publish torsion constants. J here is roughly 15% of the solid square's 0.141 a^4 (open slots make these profiles weak in torsion). Replace with a value computed from the profile's cross-section before the study's results are quoted (vt350#322).
